Aurora.desc: A soft, calm aurora that flows across the top of the page and drifts toward the cursor.

SoftAurora.desc: Soft aurora borealis shader with 3D Perlin noise and cosine gradient palettes.

Silk.desc: Flowing satin folds with glossy highlights that turn toward the cursor and ripple on click.

Prism.desc: Rotating prism of glowing spectral light with configurable shape, colors and motion.

Galaxy.desc: Endless flight through a twinkling starfield with warp jumps, cursor repulsion and star palettes.

DarkVeil.desc: A silky veil of light that drifts in the dark and bends around the cursor.

Beams.desc: Glossy ribbons that ripple in the dark and catch the light, which follows your cursor.

LightRays.desc: Volumetric light rays from any edge, with source glow and haze. The cursor steers the beam and casts a shadow.

Threads.desc: Flowing threads that fray apart and part around the cursor, from fine silk to contour lines.

Plasma.desc: Folds of satin light twisting slowly through the dark, turning to follow the cursor.

PlasmaWave.desc: Two ribbons of plasma curling through each other, with soft glow and white-hot cores.

LiquidChrome.desc: Soft ribbons of liquid chrome that swirl through a dark pool, ripple under the cursor and catch the light as it moves.

LiquidEther.desc: A glowing liquid that swirls under the cursor, colored by how fast it flows.

Hyperspeed.desc: Night highway of glowing light trails on a winding road that warps into hyperspace while you hold.

Iridescence.desc: Liquid iridescent surface with shifting folds that you can stir with the cursor.

Lightning.desc: Crackling, branching lightning that bends toward the cursor and strikes wherever you click.

FloatingLines.desc: Ribbons of fine glowing lines that drift in waves, part around the cursor and curl when clicked.

GridScan.desc: A 3D grid room swept by a scanning light that follows your view.

LightPillar.desc: A swirling pillar of light that ignites on load, leans toward the cursor and surges on click.

Lightfall.desc: Streaks of light falling down a curved tunnel, bending around the cursor and stretching into warp trails on hold.

Grainient.desc: Flowing grainy gradients you can stir with the cursor.

Dither.desc: Retro dithered waves with Bayer, halftone, line and noise patterns, palettes and cursor trails.

FaultyTerminal.desc: A flickering CRT terminal of glowing glyphs, with phosphor trails under the cursor and glitches on click.

RippleGrid.desc: A crisp grid that ripples like water, bending and lighting up as waves pass through it.

Waves.desc: Dense flowing lines that sway like silk, bend around the cursor and spring back into place.

PixelBlast.desc: Dithered pixel clouds that drift, shimmer and light up under the cursor, with ripples, shapes and a perspective floor.

LaserFlow.desc: A beam of light that splashes onto your content and pours over its corners.

ColorBends.desc: Vibrant color bends with smooth flowing animation.

Topography.desc: A 3D landscape drawn in glowing contour lines that rises under the cursor, with light pulses on click.

Strands.desc: Spectral strands that twist inside a frosted glass orb and swell into a smooth bulge where they come together, like the new Siri.

GhostFibers.desc: Layered ribbons of fine glowing fibers that twist, fold and drift through soft depth of field.

FluxLines.desc: Glowing flux lines tracing a churning magnetic fluid. The cursor magnet reveals and curls them.

SideRays.desc: Shafts of light that fan in from a corner or side, shimmer slowly and lean toward the cursor.

LightTunnel.desc: A swirling fibre-optic tunnel where comets of light race into depth, steered by the cursor.

ElasticMesh.desc: Turns text or any logo into a puffy inflated shape you can press, poke and stretch like jelly.

Orb.desc: A glowing ring of swirling color that breathes, trails an orbiting light and reaches toward the cursor.

Particles.desc: A drifting 3D field of particles with glow, twinkle, constellation lines and cursor interaction.

DotGrid.desc: A springy dot grid that the cursor flicks and drags through like jelly, with click shockwaves.

Balatro.desc: The swirling Balatro paint shader, with crisp pixels, a cursor that stirs the paint and click whirlpools.

PrismaticBurst.desc: A burst of prismatic light rays that leans toward the cursor and sends a wave of light outward on click.

MagicRings.desc: Glowing rings that pulse outward in a wave, swell toward the cursor and flare on click.

GradientBlinds.desc: Satin gradient blinds lit by a spotlight that follows the cursor, swaying and turning toward the light.

MoltenMetal.desc: Swirling caustic filaments with white-hot cores that heat up under the cursor and flare on click.

Ferrofluid.desc: A glossy sea of magnetic fluid where swells of spikes roll in and the cursor raises a crown.

Antigravity.desc: A field of particles that lifts into a glowing ring around the cursor and bursts outward on click.

Ballpit.desc: A soft-lit pit of physics balls you can shove with the cursor, grab, throw and blast apart.

MetaBalls.desc: Liquid metaballs that merge, stretch and pinch apart, with a cursor blob that pushes through them.

LineWaves.desc: Fine lines that flow in silky waves while a band of light drifts through them.

GradientWaves.desc: Lit satin waves rolling in from a hazy horizon, with a light that follows the cursor and swells on click.

ShapeWaves.desc: A field of triangles, circles and squares that brighten and grow along rolling waves.

PatternWaves.desc: A lit halftone surface of dots, lines or glyphs that moves like draped silk.

DotField.desc: A gradient dot field seen through a lens that follows the cursor, magnifying, pinching or swirling the dots.

DriftWall.desc: An endless perspective wall of tiles drifting past, lifting on hover.

CursorGrid.desc: A crisp grid whose cells light up and fade behind the cursor, with grid styles, tiles and click pulses.

WebThreads.desc: Glowing threads woven through luminous pinch points that light up under the cursor and carry light on click.

Noise.desc: Film grain overlay for photos and pages, from fine 35mm grain to dust, paper and TV static.

AcidSquares.desc: A rolling field of glossy squares that ripples under two drifting colored lights.

SpotlightCard.desc: Card lit by a soft spotlight that follows the pointer, catches its edge and reaches nearby cards.

ElectricBorder.desc: Wraps any element in crackling strands of current that surge near the cursor and leap off in sparks.

StarBorder.desc: A twinkling star that travels the exact outline of any button, pill or card, trailing light and stardust.

BorderGlow.desc: Glowing mesh-gradient border that follows cursor direction and intensifies near edges.

MagicBento.desc: A bento grid of feature cards with live artwork, edge light that follows the cursor and a click wave.

GlassSurface.desc: Apple-style liquid glass that bends what is behind it, in a rounded panel or any logo shape.

HoloCard.desc: Collectible trading card with a real holographic foil and glitter that sparkles as it tilts.

PixelCard.desc: A card that fills with twinkling pixels on hover, rippling out from the center or the cursor.

TiltedCard.desc: A 3D card that tilts toward the cursor, with glare, a soft shadow, floating layers and a flip side.

ChromaGrid.desc: A grid of grayscale photo cards where a spotlight follows the cursor and brings back color.

GlareHover.desc: A glossy light streak that sweeps across any element in the direction the cursor moves.

ReflectiveCard.desc: A metal ID card that reflects your camera or a looping video and catches the light as it tilts.

CrystalizedBall.desc: A glass ball with a crackling electric rim and glowing dust that swirls with the cursor.

SplitText.desc: Splits text into characters / words for staggered entrance animation.

BlurText.desc: Text starts blurred then crisply resolves for a soft-focus reveal effect.

DecryptedText.desc: Hacker-style decryption cycling random glyphs until resolving to real text.

ShinyText.desc: A sheen of light that sweeps across text, from soft bands to chrome-like reflections.

GradientText.desc: Living gradients inside your text: a sliding sweep, a drifting mesh or a swinging conic fan.

TextPressure.desc: Characters scale / warp interactively based on pointer pressure zone.

ScrambledText.desc: Detects cursor position and applies a distortion effect to text.

TrueFocus.desc: Applies dynamic blur / clarity based over a series of words in order.

VariableProximity.desc: Letter styling changes continuously with pointer distance mapping.

DepthText.desc: Layered extruded type with parallax that shifts against the pointer.

StrokeText.desc: Outlined letterforms draw themselves on, then flood with fill.

TechText.desc: A wordmark whose letters turn into dashed vector paths under the cursor.

MaskedHeading.desc: A headline with a drifting colour mesh or image showing through, revealed word by word.

WarpText.desc: WebGL warp that bends and refracts the text around the pointer.

ParticleText.desc: Text assembles from drifting particles that scatter and reform on demand.

Shuffle.desc: Animated text reveal where characters shuffle before settling.

GlitchText.desc: RGB split and distortion glitch effect with jitter effects.

FuzzyText.desc: Vibrating fuzzy text with controllable hover intensity.

LetterGlitch.desc: A calm field of letters that flicker, scramble and glitch in color, stirred by the cursor and torn by clicks.

TextType.desc: Typewriter effect with blinking cursor and adjustable typing cadence.

CircularText.desc: Layouts characters around a circle with optional rotation animation.

FoldText.desc: Lines unfold into place like creased paper opening flat.

EchoText.desc: Ghosted copies trail behind the text and settle into a single word.

SplitFlapText.desc: Mechanical split-flap departure board that clacks through to each new phrase.

CountUp.desc: Animated number counter supporting formatting and decimals.

Counter.desc: An odometer-style number whose digits roll to every new value, with currency, separators and locales.

Stepper.desc: A multi-step flow with a gliding step indicator, spring transitions and horizontal or vertical layouts.

Dock.desc: macOS style dock with smooth magnification, launch bounce, badges and context menus.

Cubes.desc: A grid of outlined 3D cubes that turn to face the cursor, spin when swept and ripple on click.

Magnet.desc: Elements magnetically ease toward the cursor then settle back with spring physics.

ClickSpark.desc: Bursts of sparks at every click, as dashes, comets, dots or stars, that can spill around buttons.

Stack.desc: Pile of cards you can drag, flick or click through, with thrown cards tucking underneath.

CardSwap.desc: A 3D stack of cards that sends the front card to the back on a timer, or when you fling it.

AnimatedList.desc: A scrolling list whose rows spring into view, with a gliding selection and arrow keys.

LogoLoop.desc: Continuously looping marquee of brand or tech logos with seamless repeat and hover pause.

GradualBlur.desc: Progressive edge blur for headers, footers, captions and carousels, with an optional fade to color that hides at the ends of a scroll.

ElectricLogo.desc: Turns any logo into a living lightning outline, with arcs that leap off its edges.
